status: DRAFT 2026-11-18. Prices follow the owner's rule (2026-11-03, MyDocHub): after every cost the net profit is half the total cost ($1 of total cost sells at $1.50), rounded up to the price step. A service is priced by its real cost: `measured_cost_usd` (from real runs) or, until measured, an `estimated` one. Costs are for the model of the service's tier (apps/ai/client.py): interactive = Claude Sonnet, background = DeepSeek. A service priced by units (posts of a plan) has a fixed part and a part per unit.

extract_data.name_en: Extract the data of a document (per page, up to 10)
extract_data.note: Per dense page (2026-11-03): the PDF goes to Opus as a document block, a full page of Arabic text is 3,764 input tokens (free token count) = $0.0151, and the facts grow by ~195 output tokens a page (fit of the real runs of 2026-11-02: 604 / 1,766 / 2,358 output tokens on 1 / 4 / 10 pages) = $0.0039; +10% = $0.021 a page. Fixed: the instructions (~330 tokens) and the ~410 output tokens every answer has = $0.0095 -> $0.01. out raised to 5000 so 10 dense pages are never cut off.

generate_template.name_en: Design a template of a document
generate_template.note: Measured 2026-11-02 in MyDocHub on Claude Opus: a sales invoice $0.106, an experience certificate $0.109, a cash receipt $0.103, a quotation $0.148, an employment contract $0.159. The figure used is about the 90th percentile; a very long contract can reach $0.20. Not yet measured in Wakeel.

fill_document.name_en: Fill a template with the details of one document
fill_document.note: Measured 2026-11-02 in MyDocHub: $0.017 (20 blanks), $0.017 (29), $0.035 (47), $0.040 (57). The highest seen is used.

generate_document.name_en: Create a document from a description
generate_document.note: Measured 2026-11-01/02 in MyDocHub: average $0.027, highest $0.037; the figure used is the highest seen plus a margin for long documents. Writes a text template, or revises a text document.

import_template.name_en: Turn an uploaded document into a template (free for the customer)
import_template.name_ar: تحويل مستند مرفوع إلى قالب (مجاني للعميل)
import_template.note: A gift of the platform: run, tracked, never charged. Limited per company per day (apps.documents.jobs.FREE_IMPORTS_PER_DAY). The cost is listed only so the spend is tracked.

extract_document.name_en: Read a document and fill in its details
extract_document.note: Measured 2026-11-01 in MyDocHub on Claude Opus: a 2-page PDF licence $0.018, an invoice image $0.013; about 1,600 input tokens per PDF page, so the cost is scaled to the worst case the service allows (the first 5 pages): about $0.0378. Not yet measured in Wakeel.

generate_plan.note: Re-measured 2026-11-18 inside Wakeel with real keys: 9 posts built from a library document on Claude Sonnet cost $0.104 (8,215 in / 8,117 out), of which about $0.015 is reading the source document (free to the person, so it sits in the fixed part). Earlier measure without a source: $0.066-0.069. Cost = 0.027 + 0.0085 per post. Draft.

rewrite_post.note: Measured on DeepSeek in production: average $0.0094, highest $0.0145 (10 runs). Not yet measured on Sonnet: the highest seen is used.

variant_post.name_en: Version of a post in another language or dialect

generate_report.note: Measured on DeepSeek in production: average $0.0085, highest $0.0102 (3 runs).

competitors.note: Not measured yet: about 8,000 input and 2,000 output tokens on Sonnet. Measure with a real run before launch.

ad_suggest.note: Not measured yet: about 1,000 input and 700 output tokens on Sonnet.

fetch_inbox.note: Runs on its own every 30 minutes. A gift of the platform for now (cost tracked per job): charging for an automatic job without a person asking for it is not fair until a limit per month exists.

learn.note: Measured $0.007. Runs on its own after feedback: a gift of the platform (cost tracked per job).

create_letterhead.name_en: Create a letterhead (A4 header and footer)
create_letterhead.note: Measured 2026-11-01 in MyDocHub on Claude Opus (one run). Not yet measured in Wakeel.

detect_identity.name_en: Read the company details from a document
detect_identity.note: Measured 2026-11-01 in MyDocHub on Claude Opus (one run). Not yet measured in Wakeel.

generate_mail_template.name_en: Design an e-mail template for the company
generate_mail_template.note: Measured 2026-11-02 in MyDocHub with the real key on Claude Opus (4 runs): classic $0.058, modern in Arabic $0.069, minimal $0.065, elegant $0.062; the highest seen is used. Not yet measured in Wakeel. Its price is a fixed value set by the owner (price_overrides: $0.24, 2026-11-18).

create_form.note: No AI: the cost is hosting and storage. Its price is a fixed value set by the owner (price_overrides, 2026-11-06 in MyDocHub), charged once when the form is created; its answers are not charged, a cap per form (FORM_MAX_RESPONSES) keeps the cost bounded.

price_overrides_note: Fixed prices set by the owner, in USD, not cost + profit: the brand studio (2026-11, MyDocHub: the price of one design) creating a form (2026-11-06) and designing an e-mail template (2026-11-18).
